name: craigsimps/laravel-pdf-testing
description: Pest and PHPUnit assertions against real PDF text, pages and rendered snapshots.

suggest.illuminate/support: Optional auto-discovered Laravel provider and configuration (tested on Laravel 12).
suggest.spatie/laravel-pdf: Assert directly on a PdfBuilder (tested with 1.9).
suggest.barryvdh/laravel-dompdf: Assert directly on a Dompdf PDF object (tested with 3.1).

lint: find src tests config -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
